images.title: 7 rows of 12 packets and 12 rows of 7 packets
images.purpose: Show that when the number of groups and the group size swap places the tray holds the same 84 packets.
images.composition: A wide array of 7 rows of 12 on the left and a tall array of 12 rows of 7 on the right, each with its number of groups and its group size marked and its number sentence below.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. Two arrays of butter packets side by side. Every packet is a square 34 by 34 px (corner radius 4 px) filled amber #E69F00 with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline and no marking; neighbouring packets are 4 px apart across and down. LEFT array: exactly 84 packets in 7 rows of 12 columns, top left corner at x 150 and y 280, spanning x 150 to 602 and y 280 to 542. Above it, a green #009E73 double headed arrow (3 px line) from x 150 to x 602 at y 250, with the label Group size: 12 in green bold sans-serif (36 px) centred at x 376 and y 215. At the left of it, a reddish purple #CC79A7 double headed arrow (3 px line) from y 280 to y 542 at x 120. Under it, centred at x 376: the label Number of groups: 7 at y 600 in reddish purple bold sans-serif (36 px) and the sentence 7 × 12 = 84 at y 660 in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (52 px). RIGHT array: exactly 84 packets in 12 rows of 7 columns, top left corner at x 940 and y 190, spanning x 940 to 1202 and y 190 to 642. Above it, a green double headed arrow from x 940 to x 1202 at y 160, with the label Group size: 7 in green bold sans-serif (36 px) centred at x 1071 and y 125. At the left of it, a reddish purple double headed arrow from y 190 to y 642 at x 910. Under it, centred at x 1071: the label Number of groups: 12 at y 700 in reddish purple bold sans-serif (36 px) and the sentence 12 × 7 = 84 at y 765 in dark bold sans-serif (52 px). In all there are 168 packets, none shaded, none missing. No other text anywhere. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
an array with a number of packets other than 84 or a different arrangement of rows and columns
images.takeaway: 7 groups of 12 and 12 groups of 7 are the same 84 packets: the order of the two numbers does not change the product.
images.description: Two arrays of 84 butter packets, 7 rows of 12 and 12 rows of 7, with the number of groups and the group size marked and 7 × 12 = 84 and 12 × 7 = 84 written under them.
images.context: Concept image for Change the Order, Keep the Product. It follows the idea of the figure in your maths book (butter packet arrays with the number of groups and the group size marked) and uses the numbers of this concept's own example: 7 and 12.
images.teaching_notes: Let the student count the rows and the columns of each array and compare the two totals. The slip to watch: thinking that the tray turned on its side holds a different number of packets.

image_decisions.why: The two arrays make the swap of the number of groups and the group size visible and countable, which words alone do not.
